dataset_source: NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS)
methodology_other:
Active fire / thermal anomaly detections derived from the Landsat 8/9 OLI sensor (30 m). Distributed via NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS), with the Landsat product available for Canada and the contiguous USA + Hawaii only. See https://earthdata.nasa.gov/faq/firms-faq for algorithm details, attribute schema, known limitations, and disclaimer.

Each detection is a 30 m pixel where the sensor identified a thermal anomaly. Common attributes include latitude, longitude, path/row, acquisition date/time (UTC), and detection confidence.
name: nasa-firms-active-fire-usa-contiguous-and-hawaii-landsat
notes:
Near-real-time active fire and thermal anomaly detections from NASA's [Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS)](https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/active_fire/) covering **USA (Contiguous & Hawaii)**, derived from the **Landsat** sensor family (Landsat 8 since 2013, Landsat 9 since 2021).

Each resource is an external link directly to a NASA-hosted file. The files are continuously updated as new satellite overpasses are processed (typically within 3 hours of acquisition).

**Time windows:** Last 24h, 48h, 7d (Landsat KML uses an animated 48-hour file in place of the 7-day one.)
